notes.HipLeft: The other hip, the supporting leg in Lila v10.
notes.HipRight: The hip that roots the kick in Lila v10, the near (front) leg in the facing-right kick frames. Track the same hip across the pair: a kick that changes hip mid-action with no declared transfer is a continuity break.
notes.armbands: ADOPTED 2026-10-26 (user-confirmed): two thin black buckled bands on HER LEFT upper arm, above the long black arm warmer. In a front view that arm is the VIEWER'S RIGHT. Visibility depends on perspective and facing: in a back view the same arm reads viewer's left, and in side views it may be the far arm or occluded. Absence in a frame where her left arm is not the visible/near arm is not, by itself, a missing-marker failure.
notes.traps: Bare pale legs through the cheongsam side slits are not dark legwear. Bangs cover the viewer's-right eye (her left eye); glasses sit on the viewer's-left eye (her right eye).

SadPocky.hard_case: Separate the black thigh strap from the navy skirt by position and shape, not by colour threshold alone. If the strap cannot be seen at this resolution, report marker_seen=false for that leg instead of guessing which leg carries it.

marker_notes.LeftLeg.decal: Carrot decal plus a small bunny decal on HER left upper thigh, with a pink band-aid on the knee and a white sock.
marker_notes.RightLeg.strap: Black thigh strap with a heart ring, on HER right thigh. It is a separate band on the thigh, not the navy pleated skirt. The skirt hangs from the waist; the strap sits on the leg itself. Do not merge strap and skirt by colour: both are dark, and naive colour thresholding cannot separate them.

depth: depth_rank 0 is the near (front) leg, 1 is the far (back) leg. The kicking leg in the bench cases is the near leg, drawn in front, in all kick frames.
reading_rule: Entity names Right/Left are the character's own right/left, never image left/right. Facing[left/right] is CANDIDATE viewer-side: the direction she faces in the image. A mirrored marker is a FAIL, not a cosmetic swap. Never mirror a sided marker to make a frame pass. Canonical sided names are port (her left) and starboard (her right), defined by bow direction. Right/Left are legacy aliases for starboard/port.
status: DRAFT for M1, not adopted spec, except Lila armbands (adopted 2026-10-26, see Lila notes). Sources: locked sheets lila.md (2026-09-28) and sadpocky.md (2026-09-26) only. Facing viewer-side remains CANDIDATE pending explicit confirmation.

vocabulary.bow: The character's facing direction, defined by the nose/face. Bow is forward, stern is backward (back of head). Facing is bow direction, not image left/right.
vocabulary.stern: Opposite bow, the back of the character.
vocabulary.port: The character's LEFT side when facing the bow, exactly as on a boat. Port is intrinsic to the character: it is the same leg/arm in every view, even when it appears on the image right in one view and the image left in another. PortLeg = her left leg, PortArm = her left arm.
vocabulary.starboard: The character's RIGHT side when facing the bow. StarboardLeg = her right leg, StarboardArm = her right arm. Starboard and port never swap with camera angle; only their image position does.
vocabulary.legacy_alias: Right/Left in earlier bench tokens mean starboard/port respectively (RightLeg = StarboardLeg, LeftLeg = PortLeg). New prompts and glossary entries should use port/starboard; code keeps Right/Left as aliases until the checker tokens are renamed in one deliberate pass, not piecemeal.

planes.sagittal: Vertical plane dividing port from starboard, containing the bow-stern axis. Movement in the sagittal plane is forward/backward along bow-stern: a front kick extending toward the bow, a profile view, a leg chambering forward. Bench kicks (Lila v10, SadPocky v2/v6, Raincoat) are sagittal-plane kicks.
planes.coronal: Vertical plane dividing bow from stern, containing the port-starboard axis. Movement in the coronal plane is sideways, port-to-starboard: a side kick extending sideways, a frontal view with a leg moving laterally. A coronal-plane leg change is not the same defect as a sagittal-plane leg change.
planes.axial: Horizontal plane dividing top from bottom, viewed from above/below. Movement in the axial plane is rotation around the vertical axis: turning, spinning, a top-down view. Axial movement changes bow direction without changing port/starboard identity.

vocabulary.depth_note: Near/far (depth_rank) is a camera-relative signal, not a port/starboard signal. The near leg is the one drawn over the other at a crossing, whichever side (port or starboard) it happens to be in that view.
vocabulary.bounded_context_foot: Foot, Shoe, and Sock are the same bounded context for movement: one foot area at the end of a leg, not three entities. Shoe/sock/boot masks merge into that foot area before linking to a leg.
vocabulary.out_of_scope_fall: NOT tracked in this phase: a walking character slips, falls, the starboard leg moves superior to the torso, the starboard shoe detaches and continues upward while the character lies on the ground. Detached-shoe and leg-superior-to-torso movement are out of scope; they would need a detached-object entity and their own bench case.
